product.title: Private Yellowstone Wolf Watching & Wildlife Safari + lunch

description.text: An evening-focused private safari targets wolf and predator activity in Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley with a provided lunch. Your guide uses spotting scopes at known wildlife corridors and adjusts routing for recent park sightings of bears, bison, and elk herds.

highlights: Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley predator corridors
Included picnic lunch in the park
Flexible evening timing for active wildlife hours

start.description: Early pickup from West Yellowstone area lodgings for dawn wildlife runs in Lamar Valley, WY.

end.description: Return to West Yellowstone after dusk wildlife viewing in Hayden Valley or Norris Geyser Basin.

product.itinerarySummary: An evening-focused private safari targets wolf and predator activity in Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley with a provided lunch.

itineraryItems.title: Lamar Valley
itineraryItems.description: Dawn and dusk drives through Lamar Valley for wolf, bear, and bison sightings.

itineraryItems.title: Hayden Valley
itineraryItems.description: Midday and evening scanning in Hayden Valley's open meadows and river bends.

itineraryItems.title: Mammoth Hot Springs
itineraryItems.description: Optional thermal-area stop at Mammoth Hot Springs between wildlife sessions.

itineraryItems.title: Norris Geyser Basin
itineraryItems.description: Brief boardwalk stop at Norris Geyser Basin when routing allows.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Private Yellowstone Wolf Watching & Wildlife Safari + lunch?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 6 to 9 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Yellowstone National Park?
faqs.answer: Early pickup from West Yellowstone area lodgings for dawn wildlife runs in Lamar Valley, WY.
